The festival goes further

A NEW CHAPTER.
ROOM FOR MORE CHAOS.

The first major expansion for Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem.

Inspired by India’s architecture, gardens, waterways, and celebrations, Padmara brings a distinct new atmosphere to the world of Verdantia.

Travel through a new Region Tour, meet the Royal Messenger, and test your tactics across five handcrafted arenas.

Included in Padmara

MORE WORLD.
MORE WAYS TO PLAY.

01 / THE ARENAS

Five places to make your mark

Battle among lotus ponds, temple architecture, royal courtyards, flowing waterways, and festival scenery.

02 / THE FIGHTERS

Four new rivals join the festival

Meet Arjun, Kiran, Meera, and Rohan. Bring the new competitors into local battles across Padmara.

03 / THE JOURNEY

A fresh Region Tour to conquer

Earn medals, take on new encounters, and reach a new chapter finale with its own regional soundtrack.

04 / THE DETAILS

Built for your next game night

Local multiplayer, keyboard and controller support, five new Steam achievements, and Steam Cloud support.
